scores.evidence_span: The immediate priority is not coding. It is obtaining behavioral evidence that a defined group of students or institutions will pay for a clearly measurable outcome.
scores.rationale: Explicitly prioritizes behavioral evidence before product implementation for this startup.

scores.evidence_span: Compare UK and Australian conversion using the same creative and qualification rules.
scores.rationale: Identifies comparable behavioral conversion data as evidence for evaluating the geographic choice.

scores.evidence_span: The December 2025 survey behind the [HEPI Student Generative Artificial Intelligence Survey 2026](https://www.hepi.ac.uk/reports/student-generative-ai-survey-2026/) covered 1,054 full-time UK undergraduates
scores.rationale: Provides a named, linked survey with a specific sample size and population, establishing a verifiable evidence resource for the UK discovery option.
No named option is described with a concrete fact showing that it uses intuition-only product decisions.
The report favors evidence and warns against premature commitment, but does not directly compare evidence-based and intuition-only product decisions on a common axis.

scores.evidence_span: The UK is the best-supported place to begin discovery because direct 2026 student evidence is available.
scores.rationale: Names the recommended discovery geography and explicitly gives available student evidence as the selection reason.
Several options are deferred or rejected, but none is downgraded specifically because it favors intuition-only product decisions.

scores.evidence_span: Test three landing pages: AI literacy, coursework-safe workflows, and career projects.
scores.rationale: Defines an executable experiment with three concrete startup value propositions.

scores.evidence_span: Do not scale paid acquisition if four-week retention or paid renewal remains weak.
scores.rationale: States a usable sequencing rule that conditions acquisition expansion on observed retention and renewal evidence.
No concrete condition makes intuition-only product decisions preferable to evidence-based decisions.

scores.evidence_span: The UK is the best-supported place to begin discovery because direct 2026 student evidence is available.
